requirement: For every day of the proposed stay, qualifying presence must not exceed 90 unique calendar dates in the inclusive 180-calendar-day lookback window. Entry and exit dates count. A new visa does not reset presence.

evidence_gaps.requirement: Exclusion of periods authorized under residence permits or long-stay visas
evidence_gaps.basis: Implemented solely from supplied Batch 1B specification; no corresponding evidence record found. No claim of source verification.

implementation_notes: Draft engineering implementation only. No release or evidence promotion. Effective dates remain unestablished; no temporal applicability filter configured.
The adapter supplies relevant stay intervals. No geography is inferred. Authorization belongs to each historical stay, not the applicant's residence status or a newly issued visa.

NONE is an explicit assertion of no relevant previous stays; missing interval detail may then normalize to []. An empty array never implies NONE. COMPLETE requires an explicit interval array. UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE remain UNKNOWN conservatively.

Malformed intervals are rejected, even if claimed excluded. Valid intervals outside every evaluated window cannot contribute. Unresolved authorization uses lower/upper unique-presence counts: if it cannot change compliance, PASS is possible; unresolved counts or first violation dates are never reported as exact.
No reset by calendar year, fixed blocks, or visa issuance. This is presence calculation only, not visa necessity, approval probability, or a complete eligibility determination.
